name: fewzhun-box-superengine
description: A private notes brain for a client's own Linux server, installed by Claude with nobody at the screen. Search by meaning over the active notes only, a nightly link graph, a read-only web page, per-reader tokens for a bot and Claude workers, and nightly draft notes that wait for a person to approve them. Replaced notes stay hidden, guidance never loses rank with age, and the brain stays off the public internet. Headless Linux only.
